youtube_short.description: Your credit card secretly gives you up to 55 days to pay with zero interest — that's called the float, and most people waste it completely. Instead of paying from your checking account, charge everything to the card and park that money in a high-yield savings account earning 4.5%. On $2,500/month in spending, that earns $93/month — $1,116 a year from money you were going to spend anyway. One rule: autopay the full balance every month or you lose all the gains. Open a HYSA today, set up autopay, and you've just turned the bank's own trick against them. #personalfinance #creditcards #moneyhacks #financetips #wealthbuilding
